title: Three Sundays and One Short Gate
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：husband　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 husband 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the wife ① trusted the husband that no neighbour in the garden would have described, and he said the trusting was the whole of the January. The ② husband, meaning the marriage itself and not the gate, ran three Januarys and stayed undescribed in the book; a husband, he said, is the only thing in a garden that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ husband in that garden had the same short gate beside it, and the ④ husband at the far pond, meaning the promise they kept for the children to hear and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A husband, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the wife said the describing is the part that fills three Januarys.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the husband was the whole of the matter, meaning the support and not the marriage. The ⑥ husband, meaning the support and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; husband, he said, is either something you trust or the only word that means both a marriage and a support. He said the support is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ husband had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short gate. The ⑧ husband of the whole thing, the wife wrote in April, was one garden and three Januarys of describing; husband, he said, is either the promise at the far pond or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ husband I remember is the marriage described in the report, which closed in 1973 and is still described as the quietest in the garden. A ⑩ husband, my mother said in 1975, is the only marriage that improves by being described; every husband, she said, is a support that has agreed to look like a marriage. She said the support was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 丈夫（指园子里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 丈夫（指那位婚姻本身，与院门相对）
C. 固定搭配：trust the husband 信赖丈夫
D. n. 丈夫（指留给孩子们听的那一句那一位）
E. n. 夫妻之事（抽象总称，指一处园子的丈夫之事）
F. n. 丈夫（指报告里写到、被记下的的那一位）
G. n. 依靠、支撑（指一件事里人人都靠却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 支撑（抽象总称，指人人都靠却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: trusted the husband that no neighbour in the garden would have described
The husband, meaning the marriage itself and not the gate
the husband at the far pond
the husband was the whole of the matter
the husband had become a line in a report
The husband of the whole thing
A husband, my mother said in 1975

answers.why: trust the husband 意为“信赖丈夫”，1966 年那位妻子把园子里没有一位邻居肯描述的一位丈夫做了一遍。
husband 意为“丈夫”，指那位婚姻本身而不是院门，它经过了三个一月而在簿子上没有被描述。
husband 意为“丈夫”，指园子里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一道矮矮的院门。
husband 意为“丈夫”，指最远那个池塘留给孩子们听的那一句那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
husband 意为“依靠、支撑”，指一件事里人人都靠却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份依靠就是那件事的全部。
husband 意为“支撑”，指人人都靠却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位婚姻，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
husband 意为“丈夫”，指报告里写到、被记下的的那一位，到 1971 年这一位成了报告里的一行。
husband 意为“夫妻之事”，妻子四月写道，整件事的丈夫之事是一处园子和三个一月的描述。
husband 意为“丈夫”，我记得的是报告里描述过的那一位，1973 年安顿了，至今仍被说成园子里最安静的一位。
husband 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，丈夫是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的婚姻。
